label: No CREATURE_1 has being itself as its nature
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: no CREATURE_1 is its own being. ST I q.7 a.2 ad 1, read in the pinned witness, says 'hoc est contra rationem facti, quod essentia rei sit ipsum esse eius, quia esse subsistens non est esse creatum'; that passage is the nearest source and is not attributed as a stating claim here. With R-act1 it gives the creature-reception leaf 29e71e43.
